name: tensai-plan
description: Record income and expenses, check balances per currency, budgets and spending, and manage your Tensai Plan projects.

interface.longDescription:
Tensai Plan is a money planner for people, households and small businesses. With this plugin, ChatGPT works in the Tensai Plan projects you choose, with your own role and permissions: it reads your projects and their currencies, balances per currency, categories, income and expenses (by date, category, currency or text), a spending summary per category, the budgets of a month and your recurring rules. It can record one or many movements, edit or delete a movement, record an exchange between two currencies, attach or remove receipts, set budgets, manage categories and recurring rules, correct a balance and create a new project.

Every currency is its own ledger: amounts are never converted or added across currencies, and an exchange always uses the two amounts you give. Every change is recorded in the project activity log as made by you through the connector, and the other members of the project are notified. You choose the projects when you sign in and can disconnect at any time.

Requires a Tensai Plan account (tensaiplan.com). Tensai Plan records movements in your own books; it does not connect to banks or move money.
defaultPrompt: Log a 12.50 coffee for today in my Home project.
How much did I spend on food this month?
Am I within my budgets this month?

positive.prompt: Log these expenses for today in my Home project: 12.50 coffee, 48 groceries and 30 taxi, all in USD.
positive.expected_behavior: Records three USD expenses dated today in the Home project with fitting categories (Food & Dining, Transportation) and confirms what was saved.

positive.prompt: What are my balances in the Home project?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports one balance per currency (USD and EUR) without converting or adding them together.

positive.prompt: How much did I spend on food this month, and what were my biggest expense categories?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns this month's USD spending per category from the test data (Housing, Food & Dining, Utilities, Health, Transportation) with the Food & Dining total.

positive.prompt: How close am I to my Food & Dining budget this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the 400 USD Food & Dining budget for the current month, how much of it is used and how much is left.

positive.prompt: I changed 100 USD into 92 EUR today. Record the exchange in my Home project.
positive.expected_behavior: Records an exchange of 100 USD out and 92 EUR in, using exactly those two amounts, and the EUR balance becomes 92.
